bodyHtml:
Successful Renewal of ACS Certification (Attestation de Conformité Sanitaire): Ensuring Continued Compliance in France | Aquasky

Aquasky is pleased to announce to our valued customers, distributors, and partners that we have successfully renewed the ACS (Attestation de Conformité Sanitaire) certification for our Pumplus and Mega pressure tank series. This renewal confirms the ongoing authorization of our products for the French market.

UNDERSTANDING ACS CERTIFICATION

In France, the ACS is the official and mandatory health compliance certification required for any device or accessory that comes into contact with drinking water. This certification is issued by approved laboratories based on rigorous testing standards managed by AFNOR (Association Française de Normalisation). It verifies that all materials and components do not release substances harmful to human health, thereby ensuring public safety and sanitary conformity.

 

WHAT THIS RENEWAL MEANS

The renewal process involves a rigorous re-examination and testing of our materials and production processes. By successfully passing these stringent controls, we reaffirm our commitment to:

• Uninterrupted Compliance: Our certified products remain fully authorized for installation and distribution in France.

• Highest Safety Standards: Guaranteeing the non-toxicity and sanitary conformity of our products, prioritizing end-user health.

• Quality Assurance: Validating the consistency and quality standards embedded in our manufacturing protocols.

 

AQUASKY ONGOING COMMITMENT

We understand the critical importance of sanitary compliance in the plumbing and water industry, particularly within the strict regulatory environment of France.

Successfully renewing ACS certification underscores Aquasky’s commitment to robust quality management and continuous investment in product safety. You can continue to specify, purchase, and install our Pumplus and Mega series with complete confidence, knowing they comply with the latest French public health requirements.

 

ACCESS THE CERTIFICATE

 

 

The official renewed certificate is available for review and download on our website:

ACS France Certification

For an overview of all our certifications, please visit: Aquasky Certification

If you have any questions about ACS certification or Aquasky products, please feel free to contact us.

Email: frankwang@aquasky.com.tw

Thank you for your continued trust and support. Aquasky remains dedicated to providing safe, compliant, and high-quality water system solutions for global markets.
